item.text:
Implemented the SQLite-backed job tracker across [db.ts](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-04/slot-10-pi.AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/src/db.ts), [server.ts](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-04/slot-10-pi.AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/src/server.ts), [worker.ts](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-04/slot-10-pi.AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/src/worker.ts), and [index.html](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-04/slot-10-pi.AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/ui/index.html). The API handles validation and idempotency; the worker persists progress, retries, and recovery state; the page submits jobs and polls their status.

`npm run build` passes. I also started the worker and verified a job reached `completed` with progress `2/2` and output `HELLO`. The smoke and contract checks could not run because this environment rejects loopback binding with `listen EPERM`.
